releases.body:
## What's Changed
- Allow toggling display with `H` (#12)
- Allow displaying only when suit is equipped (#17)
- Fix clock showing up on main menu (#11)
- Fix clock going negative (#16)

## What's Changed
* Version 0.7.0 EotE events by @Tllya in https://github.com/clubby789/OWClock/pull/15

> Closes #7
> It might help with #4 too because the RecalculatePosition is called every time settings are changed now.
> Remove redundant \ from build event.
> OwmlDir can be dynamic with %appdata%
> Make UniqueName match.
> Remove events from list when they have passed (Should improve performance slightly)
> RecalculatePosition from Configure to fix HudScale.
> Add comments.
> Organize code blocks.
Bringing the mod up to date, thanks to @A9G-Data-Droid

Adds some new events in, and adds filtering.

KNOWN ISSUE:
 - Changing the filters can break everything. Be careful with it.

releases.name: Improved formatting of events
releases.body: Events listed on the side will now wrap round if too long, and ad just their height accordingly. Also added some more events to the default events list.
